multiplicity_control.source_excerpt: Section 6.6.1 Multiple testing procedure -- v1 extracted text: US submission: the same dedicated modified confirmatory testing hierarchy as ECZTRA 1 -- IGA 0/1, then EASI-75, then Pruritus vs. placebo at Week 16 (5% each, sequential); if all three are significant, alpha splits between 2 Week-16 secondary endpoints (1%, Holm-adjusted) and 2 maintenance endpoints at Week 52 (4%, sequential), with alpha-recycling between groups.

rescue_therapy.source_excerpt: Section 9.7 Rescue treatment -- v1 extracted text: If medically necessary (i.e., to control intolerable AD symptoms), rescue treatment for AD may be provided to trial subjects at the discretion of the investigator. Subjects who receive rescue treatment during the initial treatment period will be considered non-responders, but continue IMP if rescue consisted of topical medications. Investigators should limit the first step of rescue to topical medications, escalating to systemic medications only after at least 14 days without adequate response. Systemic corticosteroid/immunosuppressive rescue requires immediate IMP discontinuation; IMP may resume no sooner than 5 half-lives after the last dose of systemic rescue medication.
